# Denmark Help Topics

Denmark Help Topics (45 pages): Denmark Help Topics

## Chapters
- [Denmark Help Topics](chapter_157477118810.md): Overview These help topics cover NetSuite features that are specific to companies doing business in Denmark.
  - [Denmark Account Setup](section_157494334804.md): Setting up an account for an organization doing business in Denmark usually requires enabling several features and installing some additional SuiteApps.
  - [Setting Up Denmark-specific Preferences](section_157494858827.md): To set up your NetSuite account according to Denmark-specific preferences, you must adjust your NetSuite company and subsidiary settings.
  - [Denmark-specific SuiteApps](section_161001522665.md): The following Denmark-specific SuiteApp is currently available: - Denmark Tax Reports(https://docs.
  - [Denmark Tax Topics For Accounts Without SuiteTax](section_157495175064.md): If you have a Denmark subsidiary and nexus and you have the International Tax Reports SuiteApp installed in your NetSuite account, you can generate the English or Danish version of the Denmark VAT Report.
